value.title: Contract value
value.netNote: All contract amounts are net. VAT is applied on the contractor invoice.

hints.activate: Locks the work lines and records the original contract value.
hints.suspend: Work is paused; changes can still be handled.
hints.complete: Work is finished; claims and closeout continue.
hints.close: Final. Requires all changes and unpriced work to be resolved.
hints.cancel: The draft is kept for history and can no longer be activated.

lines.title: Work lines
lines.pageDescription: Contract scope broken into measurable work lines.
lines.pricingHint: Quantity × rate lines are priced from the rate; other line types use the line amount.
lines.lockedHint: The contract is active: scope, quantity and price change only through an approved change.
lines.baselineLocked: Baseline locked. Use the Changes tab to add, deduct or re-rate work.
lines.emptyDescription: Add the lines that make up this contract before activating it.

changes.title: Changes
changes.pageDescription: Additions, deductions and instructions on this contract. Only approved changes move the contract value.
changes.notRunning: Changes can be raised once the contract is active.
changes.operationalNote: Prices and negotiation amounts are visible to users with contract financial access.
changes.emptyDescription: Changes raised by the team or proposed by the contractor appear here.

versions.label: Version {no}
versions.linesHint: When lines are entered, the total is the sum of the lines.

unpriced.pageDescription: Work carried out before it was priced. Convert each record into a change for pricing, or reject it.
unpriced.emptyDescription: Record work a contractor performed before a price was agreed so it is never lost.

portal.contractDescription: Your contract work lines and status.
portal.changesDescription: Changes on your contract and your proposals.

errors.lifecycleTransition: This status change is not allowed for the contract's current status.
errors.baselineLocked: The contract is active. Change scope, quantity or price through an approved change.
errors.changeRequiresRunningAgreement: Changes require an active or suspended contract.
errors.changeTransition: This action is not available for the change's current status.
errors.closeBlocked: Resolve all open changes and unpriced work before closing the contract.
errors.weightsIncomplete: Weighted milestone lines must total exactly 100%.
errors.additionNegative: An addition cannot reduce the contract value.
errors.deductionPositive: A deduction cannot increase the contract value.
errors.belowZero: A work line cannot be revised below zero.
errors.contractBelowZero: The contract value cannot drop below zero.
errors.vendorNotSubcontractor: Only contractors marked as subcontractors can receive a contract.
errors.numberTaken: This contract number is already used.
errors.notEditable: Closed or cancelled contracts cannot be edited.
errors.valueDerivedFromLines: The contract value is the total of its work lines.
errors.originalMismatch: The recorded original value differs from the work lines total.
errors.lineCodeTaken: This line code is already used on the contract.
errors.changeNotPriced: Price the change before approving it.
errors.lineNotActive: One of the changed lines is no longer active.
errors.cannotWithdrawExternal: A contractor proposal is rejected, not withdrawn.
errors.unpricedRequiresRunningAgreement: Unpriced work is recorded on active, suspended or completed contracts.

validation.parentContractProject: The parent contract must belong to this project.
validation.workPackageProject: The work package must belong to this project.
validation.locationProject: The location must belong to this project.
validation.versionLineTarget: Choose an existing line or describe a new one.
validation.lineNotInAgreement: This line does not belong to the contract.
validation.contractorProposalExternal: Contractor proposals are submitted from the contractor portal.
validation.newLineNegative: A new line cannot have a negative quantity or amount.
